content.json:
# Memory forensics triage
Pick an image (one database per image). Start with **Overview**: what ran, what failed, and the highest-scoring findings. Every finding explains why it matters and what commonly causes false positives.

parameters.name: Databases
parameters.label: Memory image (database)
parameters.description: One database per analysed memory image
parameters.query:
{"version": "AzureDataExplorerQuery/1.0", "queryText": ".show databases
| where DatabaseName !in ('$systemdb')
| project DatabaseName
| order by DatabaseName desc", "clusterName": "{Clustername}"}

content.json:
## Overview
What was analysed, which plugins failed, and the findings ranked across every detector in this workbook. **An empty table is not a clean result**: check *Plugin health* - a plugin that failed or is not supported on this Windows build produces no rows. Findings are leads, not verdicts: every detector lists its common false positives.

### Image

Chain of custody and context. The SHA-256 was computed by the worker on the image it analysed; compare it with the hash recorded at acquisition. Boot time is the creation time of the System process; acquisition time comes from the kernel clock.

content.noDataMessage: Nothing found (or the plugin produced no data for this image).

content.json:
### Most suspicious processes

Processes ranked by the sum of their findings (2^severity per finding: Critical 16, High 8, Medium 4, Low 2). Independent signals stacking on one process (odd parent + staging path + injected code + network) is far stronger than any single rule. Open the PID in the *Pivot* tab.

**False positives / edge cases:** JIT-heavy processes (browsers, PowerShell, .NET, AV) collect low-severity memory findings; their score is dominated by those unless other categories also fire.

{"version": "AzureDataExplorerQuery/1.0", "queryText": "let CmdHits = (text:string) {
let t = tolower(text);
pack_array(
iff(t matches regex @"(powershell|pwsh)(\.exe)?\b.*\s[-/](e|en|enc|enco\w*|ec)\s+[a-z0-9+/=]{16,}", "Medium|Execution|T1059.001|Encoded PowerShell command", ""),
iff(t has "frombase64string" or t has "[convert]::", "Medium|Defense Evasion|T1140|Base64 decoding in command line", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"\b(iex|invoke-expression)\b" and t matches regex @"(downloadstring|downloaddata|downloadfile|net\.webclient|invoke-webrequest|\biwr\b|invoke-restmethod|\birm\b|start-bitstransfer)", "High|Execution|T1059.001|PowerShell download cradle", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"\s[-/](w|wi|win|windowstyle)\s+h(idden)?\b|\s-nop(rofile)?\b|\s-(ep|exec|executionpolicy)\s+bypass", "Low|Defense Evasion|T1564.003|PowerShell stealth flags", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"certutil(\.exe)?\b.*(-urlcache|-verifyctl|-url\s)", "High|Command and Control|T1105|certutil used to download", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"certutil(\.exe)?\b.*\s-(decode|decodehex|encode)\b", "Medium|Defense Evasion|T1140|certutil encode/decode", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"bitsadmin(\.exe)?\b.*/(transfer|create|addfile|setnotifycmdline|resume)", "High|Defense Evasion|T1197|bitsadmin job", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"\b(curl|wget)(\.exe)?\s.*https?://", "Medium|Command and Control|T1105|curl/wget download", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"mshta(\.exe)?\b.*(vbscript:|javascript:|https?://|\.hta\b|getobject)", "High|Defense Evasion|T1218.005|mshta executing script or remote content", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"regsvr32(\.exe)?\b.*(/i:|scrobj\.dll|https?://|\\\\)", "High|Defense Evasion|T1218.010|regsvr32 Squiblydoo / remote scriptlet", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"rundll32(\.exe)?\b.*(javascript:|mshtml,runhtmlapplication|\\\\[a-z0-9.-]+\\|\s-sta\b)", "High|Defense Evasion|T1218.011|rundll32 script or remote DLL", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"comsvcs(\.dll)?.*(minidump|#\s*\+?-?24\b)", "Critical|Credential Access|T1003.001|LSASS dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"procdump(64)?a?(\.exe)?\b.*\s-ma\b.*lsass|\s-ma\s+lsass", "High|Credential Access|T1003.001|ProcDump of lsass", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"(sekurlsa::|privilege::debug|lsadump::|kerberos::(ptt|golden|list)|misc::memssp|token::elevate|crypto::capi|dpapi::)", "Critical|Credential Access|T1003|Mimikatz command", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"\breg(\.exe)?\s+save\s+hklm\\(sam|system|security)\b", "High|Credential Access|T1003.002|Registry hive dump (SAM/SYSTEM/SECURITY)", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"ntdsutil.*(ifm|create full)|ntds\.dit|esentutl.*ntds", "High|Credential Access|T1003.003|NTDS.dit theft", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"vssadmin(\.exe)?\s.*create\s+shadow", "Medium|Credential Access|T1003.003|Volume shadow copy created", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"vssadmin(\.exe)?\s.*(delete\s+shadows|resize\s+shadowstorage)|wmic(\.exe)?\s.*shadowcopy\s+delete|win32_shadowcopy.*(remove-|delete)|wbadmin(\.exe)?\s.*delete\s+(catalog|systemstatebackup|backup)|diskshadow(\.exe)?\s.*delete\s+shadows|bcdedit(\.exe)?\s.*(recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures)|reagentc(\.exe)?\s+/disable", "Critical|Impact|T1490|Inhibit system recovery (shadow copies / backups / boot recovery)", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"bcdedit(\.exe)?\s.*safeboot\s+(minimal|network)", "High|Defense Evasion|T1562.009|Boot into Safe Mode configured", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"wmic(\.exe)?\s.*process\s+call\s+create", "High|Execution|T1047|WMI process creation", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"\b(psexe(c|c64|svc)|paexec|csexec)\b", "High|Lateral Movement|T1569.002|PsExec-style remote execution", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"schtasks(\.exe)?\s.*/create", "Medium|Persistence|T1053.005|Scheduled task created", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"\bsc(\.exe)?\s+(\\\\\S+\s+)?(create|config)\b.*binpath", "Medium|Persistence|T1543.003|Service created or reconfigured", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"\breg(\.exe)?\s+add\s.*\\(currentversion\\run|winlogon|image file execution options)", "Medium|Persistence|T1547.001|Autorun registry key written", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"set-mppreference.*-disable(realtimemonitoring|behaviormonitoring|ioavprotection|scriptscanning)|add-mppreference.*-exclusion(path|process|extension)|disableantispyware|disableantivirus|dism.*disable-feature.*defender|\bsc(\.exe)?\s+(stop|config|delete)\s+(windefend|sense|wdnissvc)", "High|Defense Evasion|T1562.001|Microsoft Defender tampering", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"amsiutils|amsiinitfailed|amsiscanbuffer", "High|Defense Evasion|T1562.001|AMSI bypass", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"wevtutil(\.exe)?\s+(cl|clear-log)\s|clear-eventlog|remove-eventlog|fsutil(\.exe)?\s+usn\s+deletejournal", "High|Defense Evasion|T1070.001|Event log / USN journal cleared", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"netsh(\.exe)?\s.*(advfirewall\s+set\s.*state\s+off|firewall\s+set\s+opmode\s+(mode=)?disable)", "Medium|Defense Evasion|T1562.004|Firewall disabled", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"\bnet1?(\.exe)?\s+(user|group|localgroup)\s.*(/domain|domain admins|enterprise admins)", "Medium|Discovery|T1087.002|Domain account/group discovery", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"nltest(\.exe)?\s.*(/domain_trusts|/dclist:|/all_trusts)|dsquery.*trusteddomain", "Medium|Discovery|T1482|Domain trust discovery", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"\badfind\b|-sc\s+trustdmp|objectcategory=(person|computer)", "High|Discovery|T1087.002|AdFind Active Directory enumeration", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"whoami(\.exe)?\s+/(all|priv|groups)", "Low|Discovery|T1033|whoami privilege discovery", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"\bnet1?(\.exe)?\s+(user\s+\S+\s+\S+\s+/add|localgroup\s+administrators\s+\S+\s+/add)", "High|Persistence|T1136.001|Local account created / added to Administrators", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"rclone(\.exe)?\s.*\s(copy|sync|move)\s", "High|Exfiltration|T1567.002|rclone data transfer", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"\b(7z|7za|7zr|7zg|rar|winrar)(\.exe)?\s+a\s.*\s-(p|hp)\S+", "Medium|Collection|T1560.001|Password-protected archive created", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"(cmd|%comspec%).*/c.*echo.*\\pipe\\", "High|Privilege Escalation|T1134.001|Meterpreter/Cobalt Strike getsystem (named pipe)", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"\bnet1?(\.exe)?\s+stop\s.*(veeam|backup|vss|wbengine|sql|msexchange|sophos|symantec|mcafee|acronis|netbackup|veritas)|taskkill(\.exe)?\s.*/f.*/im", "Medium|Impact|T1489|Services or processes stopped", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"(msbuild|installutil|regasm|regsvcs)(\.exe)?\s.*\\(users\\public|appdata|temp|programdata)\\", "Medium|Defense Evasion|T1127|Trusted developer utility running user-writable content", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"cmstp(\.exe)?\s.*/(ni|s)\b.*\.inf", "High|Defense Evasion|T1218.003|cmstp INF execution", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"icacls(\.exe)?\s+\S+\s+/grant\s+(everyone|\*s-1-1-0):", "Medium|Impact|T1222.001|Permissions opened to Everyone", ""),
iff(t matches regex @"cipher(\.exe)?\s+/w:", "High|Impact|T1485|Free space wiped (cipher /w)", "")
)
};
let Leaf = (path:string) { tostring(split(replace_string(path, "/", @"\"), @"\")[-1]) };
let NormPath = (path:string) {
let p = tolower(trim(@"[\s""]", path));
replace_regex(replace_regex(replace_regex(replace_regex(replace_regex(p,
@"^\\\\\?\\", ""),
@"^\\\?\?\\", ""),
@"^(\\systemroot|%systemroot%)\\", @"c:\\windows\\"),
@"^\\device\\harddiskvolume\d+\\", @"c:\\"),
@"^\\windows\\", @"c:\\windows\\")
};
let Procs = () {
let listed = pslist
| project ProcKey = strcat(PID, "|", CreateTime), PID, PPID, Name = ImageFileName, CreateTime, ExitTime,
Threads, Handles, SessionId, Wow64, InPslist = true;
let scanned = psscan
| project ProcKey = strcat(PID, "|", CreateTime), PID, PPID, Name = ImageFileName, CreateTime, ExitTime,
Threads, Handles, SessionId, Wow64, InPsscan = true;
let images = union
(pebmasquerade | where EPROCESS_SeAudit_ImageFileName !in ("", "-") | project PID, Path = EPROCESS_SeAudit_ImageFileName, Rank = 1),
(dlllist | where Path endswith ".exe" | summarize arg_min(VolRow, Path) by PID | project PID, Path, Rank = 2)
| summarize arg_min(Rank, Path) by PID
| project PID, ImagePath = NormPath(Path);
let commands = cmdline
| where Args !in ("", "-") and not(Args startswith "Required memory") and Args !contains "process exited"
| summarize CommandLine = take_any(Args) by PID;
let users = getsids | summarize arg_min(VolRow, SID, Name) by PID | project PID, UserSid = SID, UserLabel = Name;
listed
| join kind=fullouter scanned on ProcKey
| project ProcKey = coalesce(ProcKey, ProcKey1), PID = coalesce(PID, PID1), PPID = coalesce(PPID, PPID1),
Name = coalesce(Name, Name1), CreateTime = coalesce(CreateTime, CreateTime1), ExitTime = coalesce(ExitTime, ExitTime1),
Threads = coalesce(Threads, Threads1), Handles = coalesce(Handles, Handles1), SessionId = coalesce(SessionId, SessionId1),
Wow64 = coalesce(Wow64, Wow641), InPslist = coalesce(InPslist, false), InPsscan = coalesce(InPsscan, false)
| lookup kind=leftouter images on PID
| lookup kind=leftouter commands on PID
| lookup kind=leftouter users on PID
| extend ImagePath = iff(InPslist, ImagePath, ""), CommandLine = iff(InPslist, CommandLine, ""),
UserSid = iff(InPslist, UserSid, ""), UserLabel = iff(InPslist, UserLabel, "")
| extend ImageName = iff(isnotempty(ImagePath), Leaf(ImagePath), tolower(Name)), Exited = isnotnull(ExitTime)
};
let Det_Commands = () {
let fromCmdline = Procs()
| where InPslist and isnotempty(CommandLine)
| extend Hits = CmdHits(CommandLine)
| mv-expand Hit = Hits to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(Hit)
| parse Hit with Severity "|" Tactic "|" Technique "|" Finding
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity, Finding = strcat(Finding, " [", Technique, "]"), Detail = CommandLine;
let fromConsole = union cmdscan, consoles
| where isnotempty(Data) and Data !in ("None", "N/A", "-") and Property !endswith ".Application" and Property !contains "Title"
| extend Hits = CmdHits(Data)
| mv-expand Hit = Hits to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(Hit)
| parse Hit with Severity "|" Tactic "|" Technique "|" Finding
| project PID, Process, Severity, Finding = strcat("Console history: ", Finding, " [", Technique, "]"), Detail = substring(Data, 0, 500);
let profiler = envars
| where Variable in~ ("COR_ENABLE_PROFILING", "CORECLR_ENABLE_PROFILING") and Value == "1"
| join kind=inner (envars | where Variable matches regex @"(?i)^(COR|CORECLR)_PROFILER_PATH(_32|_64)?$" | project PID, ProfilerPath = Value) on PID
| project PID, Process, Severity = iff(ProfilerPath matches regex @"(?i)\\program files", "Medium", "High"),
Finding = ".NET profiler loaded via environment (COR_PROFILER hijack) [T1574.012]", Detail = ProfilerPath;
union fromCmdline, fromConsole, profiler
| extend Category = "Execution"
};
let ShellNames = dynamic(["cmd.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "powershell_ise", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "mshta.exe",
"rundll32.exe", "regsvr32.exe", "certutil.exe", "bitsadmin.exe", "curl.exe", "wmic.exe", "schtasks.exe", "msbuild.exe",
"installutil.ex", "regasm.exe", "regsvcs.exe", "msiexec.exe", "hh.exe", "forfiles.exe", "msdt.exe", "odbcconf.exe",
"net.exe", "net1.exe", "whoami.exe", "nltest.exe", "reg.exe", "sc.exe", "bash.exe", "wsl.exe", "certreq.exe",
"bcdedit.exe", "vssadmin.exe", "wevtutil.exe", "netsh.exe", "systeminfo.exe", "quser.exe", "qwinsta.exe",
"hostname.exe", "ipconfig.exe", "arp.exe", "nslookup.exe", "tasklist.exe", "taskkill.exe", "cmstp.exe",
"psexec.exe", "psexec64.exe", "adfind.exe"]);
let Det_Credentials = () {
let lsassAllow = dynamic(["system", "lsass.exe", "csrss.exe", "wininit.exe", "services.exe", "svchost.exe", "lsm.exe", "msmpeng.exe",
"mssense.exe", "sensendr.exe", "senseir.exe", "sysmon.exe", "sysmon64.exe", "vmtoolsd.exe", "taskmgr.exe",
"procexp.exe", "procexp64.exe", "wmiprvse.exe", "mpdefendercore", "csfalconservic", "sentinelagent."]);
let lsassHandles = handles
| where Type == "Process" and Name matches regex @"(?i)^lsass\.exe Pid \d+$"
| extend Target = tolong(extract(@"Pid (\d+)$", 1, Name)), Access = tolower(GrantedAccess), LName = tolower(Process)
| where PID != Target
| extend VmRead = Access matches regex @"[13579bdf][0-9a-f]$", DupHandle = Access matches regex @"[4567cdef][0-9a-f]$"
| where VmRead or DupHandle or Access in ("0x1fffff", "0x1f0fff", "0x1f1fff", "0x1f2fff", "0x1f3fff")
| extend Severity = case(LName in (lsassAllow) and not(LName == "svchost.exe" and Access == "0x14c0"), "Low",
LName in (ShellNames) or LName matches regex @"^(procdump|python|mimikatz|nanodump|rundll32)", "Critical",
LName == "svchost.exe", "High",
"High")
| where Severity != "Low"
| project PID, Process, Severity, Finding = "Handle to lsass.exe with memory-read / duplicate access (credential dumping)",
Detail = strcat(Process, " (", PID, ") holds ", Access, iff(VmRead, " [VM_READ]", ""), iff(DupHandle, " [DUP_HANDLE]", ""), " on lsass (", Target, ")");
let pipes = handles
| where Type == "File" and Name startswith @"\Device\NamedPipe\"
| extend Pipe = substring(Name, strlen(@"\Device\NamedPipe\")), LName = tolower(Process)
| extend Rule = case(
Pipe matches regex @"(?i)^(MSSE-\d{1,4}-server|postex_[0-9a-f]{2,4}|postex_ssh_|status_[0-9a-f]{2}|msagent_[0-9a-f]{2,4})", "Critical|Cobalt Strike default named pipe",
Pipe matches regex @"(?i)^(mojo\.5688\.8052\.(183894939787088877|35780273329370473)[0-9a-f]{2}|wkssvc_?[0-9a-f]{2}$|ntsvcs_?[0-9a-f]{2}$|DserNamePipe[0-9a-f]{2}|SearchTextHarvester[0-9a-f]{2}|mypipe-(f|h)[0-9a-f]{2}|windows\.update\.manager[0-9a-f]{2,3}|scerpc_?[0-9a-f]{2}$|PGMessagePipe[0-9a-f]{2}|MsFteWds[0-9a-f]{2}|f4c3[0-9a-f]{2}|f53f[0-9a-f]{2}$|fullduplex_[0-9a-f]{2}|msrpc_[0-9a-f]{4}|rpc_[0-9a-f]{2}$|spoolss_[0-9a-f]{2}$)", "High|Cobalt Strike malleable-profile named pipe",
Pipe matches regex @"(?i)^(cachedump|lsadump|wceservicepipe)", "Critical|Credential dumping tool named pipe",
Pipe matches regex @"(?i)^(gruntsvc|jaccdpqnvbrrxlaf|posh|csexecsvc|583da945-62af-10e8-4902-a8f205c72b2e|ahexec|isapi_http|isapi_dg|namepipe_morewindows|dce_3d|bizkaz)", "High|Known C2 / malware named pipe",
Pipe matches regex @"(?i)^(psexesvc|paexec|remcom_communica)", "High|PsExec-style remote execution pipe",
Pipe matches regex @"(?i)^(interprocess_|samr_|netlogon_|srvsvc_|lsarpc_)[0-9a-f]", "Medium|Pipe name with Cobalt Strike-style hex suffix",
Pipe matches regex @"(?i)^mojo_" and LName !in ("chrome.exe", "msedge.exe", "msedgewebview2", "brave.exe", "opera.exe"), "Medium|Chrome-like mojo_ pipe in a non-browser process",
"")
| where isnotempty(Rule)
| parse Rule with Severity "|" Finding
| summarize Pipes = make_set(Pipe, 10) by PID, Process, Severity, Finding
| project PID, Process, Severity, Finding, Detail = strcat_array(Pipes, ", ");
let secrets = lsadump
| extend Rule = case(Key == "DefaultPassword" and not(Hex matches regex @"^(00\s*){16,}$") and isnotempty(Secret), "High|Autologon password stored as LSA secret (DefaultPassword)",
Key startswith "_SC_", "Medium|Service account password stored as LSA secret",
Key matches regex @"(?i)^(RasDialParms|RasCredentials|L\$_Ras)", "Medium|Saved VPN/RAS credentials",
Key matches regex @"(?i)^G\$BCKUPKEY", "Medium|DPAPI domain backup key",
"")
| where isnotempty(Rule)
| parse Rule with Severity "|" Finding
| project PID = long(null), Process = "", Severity, Finding, Detail = Key;
let cached = cachedump
| where Username matches regex @"(?i)(^adm|admin|^da[_-]|[_.-]a$|svc|sql|backup|t0|tier0)"
| project PID = long(null), Process = "", Severity = "Medium", Finding = "Cached domain credential for a privileged-looking account",
Detail = strcat(Domain, "\\", Username, " (crack offline: hashcat -m 2100)");
let skeleton = skeleton_key_check
| where SkeletonKeyFound
| project PID, Process, Severity = "Critical", Finding = "Skeleton Key: RC4-HMAC functions in lsass patched",
Detail = strcat("Initialize ", rc4HmacInitialize, ", Decrypt ", rc4HmacDecrypt);
let privs = privileges
| where Privilege in ("SeDebugPrivilege", "SeLoadDriverPrivilege", "SeTcbPrivilege", "SeCreateTokenPrivilege", "SeTakeOwnershipPrivilege")
and Attributes has "Enabled" and Attributes !has "Default"
| where tolower(Process) in (ShellNames) or tolower(Process) matches regex @"^(procdump|python|mimikatz|nanodump)"
| summarize Privs = make_set(Privilege) by PID, Process
| project PID, Process, Severity = "High", Finding = "Shell/tool enabled a dangerous privilege itself",
Detail = strcat_array(Privs, ", ");
union lsassHandles, pipes, secrets, cached, skeleton, privs
| extend Category = "Credential access"
};
let ToolNames = @"(^|\\)(mimikatz|mimilib|mimidrv|procdump(64)?a?|psexec(64)?|psexesvc|paexec|csexec(svc)?|remcom(svc)?|rclone|adfind|sharphound|bloodhound|azurehound|rubeus|seatbelt|lazagne|safetykatz|nanodump|secretsdump|crackmapexec|netexec|nxc|kerbrute|certify|certipy|pingcastle|grixba|netscan|advanced_ip_scanner|advanced_port_scanner|angryip|ipscan|anydesk|ateraagent|splashtop\w*|ngrok|cloudflared|plink|chisel|ligolo[\w-]*|winscp|megasync|megacmd\w*|filezilla|restic|pchunter(32|64)?|processhacker|gmer|powertool|backstab(64)?|edrkillshifter|defendercontrol|advancedrun|systembc|7za|7zr|wce|pwdump\d*|gsecdump|dumpert|outflank|sharpdpapi|sharpchrome|snaffler|invoke-mimikatz)\.(exe|dll|sys|ps1|py)$";
let Det_Files = () {
let files = filescan
| extend N = tolower(Name)
| summarize take_any(Offset) by N, Name;
let fileRules = files
| extend Rule = case(
N matches regex @"\\(andrew|coredump|lsass|pplblade|rustive|dumpert)\.dmp$|\\(lsass\.(zip|rar)|notlsass\.zip)$|\\lsass[^\\]*\.dmp$|\\(nanodump|proc_)[^\\]*\.dmp$", "Critical|LSASS memory dump file [T1003.001]",
N matches regex @"\\(sam|system|security)\.(save|sav|hive|hiv|bak|bck|backup|export)$|\\hive_sam_|\\sam-20\d\d-|\\sam-haxx|_shadowsteal\.zip$", "High|Copy of a credential registry hive [T1003.002]",
N endswith @"\ntds.dit" and N !startswith @"\windows\ntds\", "High|NTDS.dit outside \\Windows\\NTDS [T1003.003]",
N matches regex @"\.kirbi$", "High|Kerberos ticket file (.kirbi) [T1558]",
N matches regex ToolNames, "High|Intrusion / dual-use tool on disk",
N matches regex @"\\(ad_users|ad_computers|ad_ous|ad_group|trustdmp|subnets)\.txt$|\\(\w+_)?\d{14}_bloodhound\.zip$|\\(\w+_)?\d{14}_(computers|users|groups|domains|gpos|ous|containers)\.json$", "High|Active Directory recon output (AdFind/SharpHound) [T1087]",
N matches regex @"\\rclone\.conf$|\\ngrok\.yml$", "High|Exfiltration / tunnel tool configuration [T1567]",
N matches regex @"\\(ryukreadme\.(txt|html)|readme\.blacksuit\.txt|akira_readme\.txt|!!!read_me_medusa!!!\.txt|criticalbreachdetected\.pdf|look at this instruction\.txt|how_to_decrypt\.txt|read_note\.html|instructions_read_me\.txt|cactus\.readme\.txt|inc-readme\.(txt|html)|readme_to_decrypt\.html|restore-my-files\.txt|@please_read_me@\.txt|decrypt-files\.txt|how_to_recover_data\.html|readme_safepay\.txt|how to restore your files\.txt|recover-files\.txt)$|\\[a-z0-9]{6,12}\.readme\.txt$|\\recover-[a-z0-9]{5,10}-files\.txt$", "Critical|Ransom note [T1486]",
N matches regex @"^\\(users\\[^\\]+\\(downloads|desktop|documents)|users\\[^\\]+\\appdata\\local\\temp|windows\\temp|users\\public|programdata|perflogs|\$recycle\.bin|temp|intel)\\.*\.(hta|js|jse|vbs|vbe|wsf|sct|scr|cpl|xll|one|iso|img|vhd|vhdx)$", "High|Script or disk-image container in a staging folder [T1204]",
N matches regex @"^\\(users\\[^\\]+\\appdata\\local\\temp|windows\\temp|users\\public|programdata|perflogs|\$recycle\.bin)\\.*\.(ps1|bat|cmd|msi|lnk)$" and N !contains "__psscriptpolicytest_", "Medium|Script in a staging folder [T1059]",
N matches regex @"^\\[^\\]+\.(exe|dll|scr|bat|ps1)$", "Medium|Executable in the root of a volume",
N matches regex @"\.(pdf|docx?|xlsx?|pptx?|rtf|txt|jpe?g|png|zip|rar)\s*\.(exe|scr|com|pif|bat|cmd|lnk|js|vbs|hta|ps1)$", "High|Document-like double extension [T1036.007]",
N matches regex @"\\sysvol\\[^\\]+\\policies\\\{[0-9a-f-]{36}\}\\(machine|user)\\(scripts\\(startup|logon)\\[^\\]+\.(bat|cmd|ps1|exe|vbs)|preferences\\scheduledtasks\\scheduledtasks\.xml)", "Medium|GPO script or scheduled task (mass deployment?) [T1484.001]",
N endswith ".dsh", "High|diskshadow script (shadow copy deletion / NTDS theft) [T1490]",
"")

let ProcTree = () {
let p = Procs();
let parents = p
| project PPID = PID, ParentKey = ProcKey, ParentName = Name, ParentImage = ImageName, ParentCreateTime = CreateTime,
ParentExitTime = ExitTime, ParentPath = ImagePath, ParentCommandLine = CommandLine,
ParentUserSid = UserSid, ParentSessionId = SessionId;
let matched = p
| join kind=inner parents on PPID
| where PPID == 4 or isnull(CreateTime) or isnull(ParentCreateTime) or ParentCreateTime <= CreateTime + 10s
| summarize arg_max(ParentCreateTime, *) by ProcKey
| project-away PPID1
| extend ParentState = "found";
let unmatched = p
| join kind=leftanti matched on ProcKey
| join kind=leftouter (parents | summarize Later = count() by PPID) on PPID
| extend ParentState = iff(coalesce(Later, 0) > 0, "pid-reused", "gone")
| project-away PPID1, Later;
union matched, unmatched
};

let Det_ProcessBaseline = () {
let critical = dynamic(["lsass.exe", "services.exe", "wininit.exe", "lsaiso.exe", "smss.exe", "csrss.exe", "winlogon.exe"]);
let core = ProcTree()
| extend LName = tolower(Name)
| join kind=inner (CoreBaseline | project-rename LName = Name) on LName
| extend Base = iff(LName in (critical), "Critical", "High");
let wrongParent = core
| where ParentState == "found" and array_length(Parents) > 0
and not(set_has_element(Parents, tolower(ParentName)))
and not(ParentMayBeGone and isnotnull(ParentExitTime))
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = Base, Finding = "Core process with an unexpected parent",
Detail = strcat(Name, " (", PID, ") was started by ", ParentName, " (", PPID, "); expected ", strcat_array(Parents, " or "));
let missingParent = core
| where not(Exited) and ParentState != "found" and not(ParentMayBeGone) and array_length(Parents) > 0
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = "Medium", Finding = "Parent of a core process is not in memory",
Detail = strcat(Name, " (", PID, ") parent PID ", PPID, " ", ParentState, "; expected ", strcat_array(Parents, " or "), " to still be running");
let wrongPath = core
| where isnotempty(PathRegex) and isnotempty(ImagePath) and not(ImagePath matches regex PathRegex)
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = "Critical", Finding = "Core process name running from an unexpected path",
Detail = strcat(ImagePath, " (expected ", PathRegex, ")");
let wrongSession = core
| where not(Exited) and ((Session == "0" and SessionId != 0) or (Session == "1+" and SessionId == 0))
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = Base, Finding = "Core process in an unexpected session",
Detail = strcat(Name, " runs in session ", SessionId, "; expected session ", Session);
let wrongUser = core
| where not(Exited) and SystemOnly and isnotempty(UserSid) and UserSid != "S-1-5-18"
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = "Critical", Finding = "Core process not running as SYSTEM",
Detail = strcat(Name, " token user is ", UserSid, " ", UserLabel);
let lateStart = core
| where not(Exited) and AtBoot and CreateTime > BootTime + 10m
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = "Medium", Finding = "Boot-time process started late",
Detail = strcat(Name, " started ", CreateTime - BootTime, " after boot (", CreateTime, ")");
let tooMany = core
| where not(Exited) and Singleton != ""
| extend Scope = iff(Singleton == "session", tostring(SessionId), "system")
| summarize Instances = count(), PIDs = make_list(PID), Severity = take_any(Base) by Name, LName, Scope
| where Instances > 1
| mv-expand PID = PIDs to typeof(long)
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity, Finding = "More instances than expected",
Detail = strcat(Instances, " live instances of ", Name, iff(Scope == "system", "", strcat(" in session ", Scope)), ": ", strcat_array(PIDs, ", "));
let lsmOnWin10 = core
| where LName == "lsm.exe" and not(Exited) and toint(toscalar(info | where Variable == "NtMajorVersion" | project Value | take 1)) >= 10
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = "High", Finding = "lsm.exe on Windows 10+",
Detail = "lsm.exe only exists up to Windows 7; on later versions this name is a masquerade";
union wrongParent, missingParent, wrongPath, wrongSession, wrongUser, lateStart, tooMany, lsmOnWin10
| extend Category = "Process baseline"
};
let AcquiredAt = toscalar(info | where Variable == "SystemTime" | project todatetime(Value) | take 1);
let Det_ProcessLocation = () {
let procs = Procs();
let staging = procs
| where InPslist and isnotempty(ImagePath)
| extend Severity = case(ImagePath matches regex StagingDirHigh, "High", ImagePath matches regex StagingDirMedium, "Medium", "")
| where isnotempty(Severity)
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity, Finding = "Process image in a staging / user-writable directory", Detail = ImagePath;
let svchostNoK = procs
| where tolower(Name) == "svchost.exe" and InPslist and not(Exited) and isnotempty(CommandLine) and CommandLine !contains "-k"
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = "High", Finding = "svchost.exe without a -k service group", Detail = CommandLine;
let unlinked = procs
| where InPsscan and not(InPslist) and not(Exited) and CreateTime between (BootTime .. coalesce(AcquiredAt, now()))
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = "High", Finding = "Running process missing from the active process list (unlinked?)",

| where not(pslist) and (thrdscan or csrss) and (isempty(ExitTime) or ExitTime in ("N/A", "-"))

| extend Category = "Process location"

| extend Image = iff(BinaryRegistry !in ("", "N/A", "-"), BinaryRegistry, Binary), LName = tolower(Name)

Name matches regex @"^([A-Za-z]{4}|[A-Za-z]{8}|[A-Za-z]{16})$" and Image matches regex @"(?i)^%systemroot%\\[a-z]{8}\.exe$", "High|Impacket/Metasploit psexec service [T1569.002]",
SuspiciousData(Image), "High|Service command line is suspicious [T1543.003]",
Type has "DRIVER" and isnotempty(Image) and Image !in ("N/A", "-") and not(Image startswith @"\Driver\" or Image startswith @"\FileSystem\")
and not(P matches regex @"\\system32\\(drivers|driverstore\\filerepository)\\"), iff(P matches regex StagingDirHigh or P matches regex StagingDirMedium, "High|Kernel driver loaded from a user-writable path [T1543.003]", "Medium|Kernel driver outside the driver directories [T1543.003]"),
Type !has "DRIVER" and (P matches regex StagingDirHigh or P matches regex StagingDirMedium), "High|Service binary in a user-writable directory [T1543.003]",
Dll !in ("", "N/A", "-") and not(DllP matches regex @"^c:\\windows\\system32\\") and DllP !contains "printconfig.dll", "High|svchost ServiceDll outside System32 [T1543.003]",
Image matches regex @"(?i)screenconnect\.clientservice|anydesk|ateraagent|splashtop|teamviewer|rustdesk|meshagent", "Medium|Remote management (RMM) service [T1219]",
"")
| where isnotempty(Rule)
| parse Rule with Severity "|" Finding
| project PID = iff(PID > 0, PID, long(null)), Process = Name, Severity, Finding,
Detail = strcat(Name, " (", Display, ") ", State, " ", Start, ": ", Image, iff(Dll !in ("", "N/A", "-"), strcat(" | ServiceDll ", Dll), ""));
let hidden = svcdiff
| project PID = iff(PID > 0, PID, long(null)), Process = Name, Severity = "High", Finding = "Service hidden from the services.exe list (svcdiff)",
Detail = strcat(Name, " ", State, ": ", iff(BinaryRegistry !in ("", "N/A", "-"), BinaryRegistry, Binary));
let tasks = scheduled_tasks
| extend Cmd = strcat(Action, " ", ActionArguments), WD = tolower(WorkingDirectory)
| extend Rule = case(
TaskName matches regex @"^[A-Za-z]{8}$" and (TriggerDescription contains "2015-07-15T20:35:13" or ActionArguments matches regex @"(?i)/c .*>\s*%windir%\\temp\\[a-z]{8}\.tmp 2>&1"), "Critical|Impacket atexec scheduled task [T1053.005]",
SuspiciousData(Cmd) and TriggerType in ("Logon", "Boot", "Session", "Event"), "High|Scheduled task runs a suspicious command at logon/boot [T1053.005]",
SuspiciousData(Cmd) or SuspiciousData(WD), "High|Scheduled task runs a suspicious command [T1053.005]",
tolower(Cmd) matches regex ToolNames, "High|Scheduled task runs a known intrusion tool [T1053.005]",
TaskName in ("N/A", "-", ""), "Medium|Scheduled task without a Tree entry (hidden/orphaned) [T1053.005]",
TaskName matches regex @"^(\{[0-9A-Fa-f-]{36}\}|[A-Za-z0-9]{6,10})$" and not(Action matches regex @"(?i)\\(windows|program files)"), "Medium|Randomly named scheduled task outside system paths [T1053.005]",
"")
| where isnotempty(Rule)
| parse Rule with Severity "|" Finding
| project PID = long(null), Process = TaskName, Severity, Finding,
Detail = strcat(TaskName, " [", TriggerType, ", ", PrincipalID, ", enabled=", Enabled, "]: ", Cmd);
union svcRules, hidden, tasks
| extend Category = "Services & tasks"
};
let AllFindings = () {
union Det_ProcessBaseline(), Det_Masquerade(), Det_ProcessLocation(), Det_ParentChild(), Det_Identity(), Det_Commands(),
Det_Injection(), Det_Credentials(), Det_Network(), Det_Persistence(), Det_Posture(), Det_Services(), Det_Kernel(),
Det_Files(), Det_Misc()
| extend SeverityRank = SevRank(Severity)
};
let details = Procs() | where InPslist | summarize arg_max(CreateTime, ImagePath, CommandLine, UserSid, SessionId) by PID;
AllFindings()
| where isnotnull(PID) and SeverityRank >= 1
| summarize Score = sum(pow(2, SeverityRank)), Findings = count(), MaxRank = max(SeverityRank),
            Categories = make_set(Category), Reasons = make_set(Finding, 12) by PID, Process
| extend Severity = case(MaxRank == 4, "Critical", MaxRank == 3, "High", MaxRank == 2, "Medium", "Low")
| lookup kind=leftouter details on PID
| project Score, Severity, PID, Process, Findings, Categories, Reasons, ImagePath, CommandLine, UserSid, SessionId, CreateTime
| order by Score desc
| take 50", "clusterName": "{Clustername}", "databaseName": "{Databases}"}

let ProcTree = () {
let p = Procs();
let parents = p
| project PPID = PID, ParentKey = ProcKey, ParentName = Name, ParentImage = ImageName, ParentCreateTime = CreateTime,
ParentExitTime = ExitTime, ParentPath = ImagePath, ParentCommandLine = CommandLine,
ParentUserSid = UserSid, ParentSessionId = SessionId;
let matched = p
| join kind=inner parents on PPID
| where PPID == 4 or isnull(CreateTime) or isnull(ParentCreateTime) or ParentCreateTime <= CreateTime + 10s
| summarize arg_max(ParentCreateTime, *) by ProcKey
| project-away PPID1
| extend ParentState = "found";
let unmatched = p
| join kind=leftanti matched on ProcKey
| join kind=leftouter (parents | summarize Later = count() by PPID) on PPID
| extend ParentState = iff(coalesce(Later, 0) > 0, "pid-reused", "gone")
| project-away PPID1, Later;
union matched, unmatched
};

let Det_Kernel = () {
let byovd = @"(?i)^(rtcore64|gdrv|dbutil_2_3|procexp(152)?|asw(arpot|vmm)|avgarpot|zam(64|guard64)|amsdk|mhyprot2|iqvw64e|truesight|rentdrv2|tfsysmon|viragt64|bdapiutil64|k7rkscan|throttlestop|rwdrv|hlpdrv|gmer64|probmon|hwrwdrv|kprocesshacker|wsftprm|tdevflt|ene|asio[23]?|winring0x64|nvoclock|atszio64|capcom|iobitunlocker|wnbios|ksapi)(\.sys)?$";
let noModule = dynamic(["", "-", "N/A"]);
let callbacksUnknown = callbacks
| where Module in (noModule)
| project PID = long(null), Process = "", Severity = "High", Finding = "Kernel callback in code that belongs to no loaded module",
Detail = strcat(Type, " -> ", Callback, " ", Detail);
let ssdtHooks = ssdt
| where Module in (noModule) or tolower(Module) !in ("ntoskrnl", "ntkrnlmp", "ntkrnlpa", "ntkrpamp")
| project PID = long(null), Process = "", Severity = "High", Finding = "SSDT entry not pointing into the kernel (hook)",
Detail = strcat("Index ", Index, " ", Symbol, " -> ", Address, " in ", Module);
let irpHooks = driverirp
| where Module in (noModule)
| summarize IRPs = make_set(IRP, 10) by DriverName, Address
| project PID = long(null), Process = "", Severity = "High", Finding = "Driver IRP handler in code that belongs to no module",
Detail = strcat(DriverName, " ", strcat_array(IRPs, ", "), " -> ", Address);
let timersUnknown = timers
| where Module in (noModule)
| project PID = long(null), Process = "", Severity = iff(Periodms > 0, "High", "Medium"), Finding = "Kernel timer DPC in code that belongs to no module",
Detail = strcat("Routine ", Routine, ", period ", Periodms, " ms");
let orphanThreads = orphan_kernel_threads
| project PID, Process = "System", Severity = "High", Finding = "System thread starting outside any loaded driver (orphan kernel thread)",
Detail = strcat("TID ", TID, " start ", StartAddress, " ", StartPath, " created ", CreateTime);
let driverNoModule = drivermodule
| where not(KnownException)
| project PID = long(null), Process = "", Severity = "High", Finding = "Driver object whose code is in no loaded module (hidden/unlinked driver)",
Detail = strcat(DriverName, " ", ServiceKey, " ", AlternativeName);
let hiddenModules = modscan
| join kind=leftanti modules on Base
| join kind=leftouter (unloadedmodules | summarize Unloaded = max(Time) by Name) on Name
| project PID = long(null), Process = "", Severity = iff(isnull(Unloaded), "High", iff(Name matches regex byovd, "High", "Medium")),
Finding = iff(isnull(Unloaded), "Driver found by pool scan but not in the loaded module list (unlinked?)", "Unloaded driver still in memory"),
Detail = strcat(Name, " ", Path, iff(isnotnull(Unloaded), strcat(" (unloaded ", Unloaded, ")"), ""));
let vulnerable = union (modules | project Name, Path, Src = "loaded"), (modscan | project Name, Path, Src = "pool scan"),
(unloadedmodules | project Name, Path = "", Src = strcat("unloaded ", Time))
| where Name matches regex byovd
| summarize Seen = make_set(Src) by Name, Path
| project PID = long(null), Process = "", Severity = "High", Finding = "Known vulnerable driver (BYOVD - used to kill EDR)",
Detail = strcat(Name, " ", Path, " [", strcat_array(Seen, ", "), "]");
let oddPaths = modules
| extend P = NormPath(Path)
| where isnotempty(Path) and not(P matches regex @"^c:\\windows\\(system32|syswow64)\\") and not(P matches regex @"\\(driverstore|drivers)\\")
and not(Name startswith "dump_")
| project PID = long(null), Process = "", Severity = iff(P matches regex StagingDirHigh or P matches regex StagingDirMedium, "High", "Medium"),
Finding = "Kernel module loaded from an unusual path", Detail = strcat(Name, " ", Path);
let attached = devicetree
| where Type == "ATT" and tolower(DriverName) has_any ("tcpip", "kbdclass", "ntfs", "fastfat") and DriverNameOfAttDevice !has "FltMgr"
| project PID = long(null), Process = "", Severity = "Medium", Finding = "Filter driver attached to the network/keyboard/file-system stack",
Detail = strcat(DriverNameOfAttDevice, " attached to ", DriverName, " ", DeviceName);
union callbacksUnknown, ssdtHooks, irpHooks, timersUnknown, orphanThreads, driverNoModule, hiddenModules, vulnerable, oddPaths, attached
| extend Category = "Kernel"
};
let Det_Masquerade = () {
let coreNames = dynamic(["svchost.exe", "lsass.exe", "csrss.exe", "services.exe", "winlogon.exe", "wininit.exe", "explorer.exe",
"smss.exe", "spoolsv.exe", "conhost.exe", "taskhostw.exe", "dllhost.exe", "rundll32.exe", "lsaiso.exe",
"runtimebroker.", "searchindexer.", "msmpeng.exe", "userinit.exe", "iexplore.exe"]);
let typos = dynamic(["svch0st.exe", "scvhost.exe", "svchosts.exe", "svchost32.exe", "svhost.exe", "schost.exe", "svchos.exe", "svchosl.exe",
"svhost32.exe", "scvh0st.exe", "lsasss.exe", "lsas.exe", "1sass.exe", "lsass32.exe", "lssass.exe", "lssas.exe", "lass.exe",
"expl0rer.exe", "explorers.exe", "iexplorer.exe", "c0nhost.exe", "conhosts.exe", "csrsss.exe", "crss.exe", "csrs.exe",
"smss32.exe", "winlogin.exe", "winlog0n.exe", "services32.exe", "servlces.exe", "spoolsvc.exe", "dllhst.exe",
"rundl32.exe", "runddl32.exe", "taskhost32.exe", "userinlt.exe", "wininlt.exe", "msmpengs.exe"]);
let allowed = dynamic(["dashost.exe", "sihost.exe", "taskhost.exe", "taskhostex.exe", "smsvchost.exe", "consent.exe", "lsm.exe",
"wudfhost.exe", "unsecapp.exe", "sppsvc.exe", "vssvc.exe", "wsmprovhost.ex", "mpdefendercore", "nissrv.exe",
"searchhost.exe", "searchapp.exe", "sihclient.exe", "logonui.exe", "axinstui.exe", "cacls.exe", "colorcpl.exe",
"epdservice.exe", "ism.exe", "msg.exe", "nethost.exe", "pairtool.exe", "printui.exe", "resetengine.ex",
"rstrui.exe", "shellhost.exe", "synchost.exe", "tscon.exe", "verclsid.exe", "vmms.exe", "wwahost.exe"]);
let procs = Procs() | where InPslist or not(Exited) | extend LName = tolower(Name);
let knownTypo = procs
| where LName in (typos)
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = "High", Finding = "Known typosquat of a core Windows process name",
Detail = strcat(Name, iff(isnotempty(ImagePath), strcat(", image ", ImagePath), ""));
let lookalike = procs
| where LName !in (coreNames) and LName !in (allowed) and LName !in (typos) and strlen(LName) between (6 .. 16)
| where not(ImagePath matches regex @"^c:\\windows\\(system32|syswow64|winsxs)\\|^c:\\windows\\[^\\]+$")
| mv-apply Core = coreNames to typeof(string) on (
extend Similarity = todouble(jaccard_index(to_utf8(LName), to_utf8(Core)))
| where Similarity >= 0.8 and abs(strlen(LName) - strlen(Core)) <= 2
| top 1 by Similarity desc)
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = iff(isempty(ImagePath), "Medium", "High"), Finding = "Name resembles a core Windows process",
Detail = strcat(Name, " looks like ", Core, " (similarity ", round(todouble(Similarity), 2), ")", iff(isnotempty(ImagePath), strcat(", image ", ImagePath), ""));
let oddChars = procs
| where Name matches regex @"[^\x20-\x7e]" or ImagePath matches regex @"[\x{200b}-\x{200f}\x{202a}-\x{202e}\x{2066}-\x{2069}]"
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = "High", Finding = "Non-printable or bidirectional characters in process name/path (RTLO)",
Detail = strcat(Name, " ", ImagePath);
let doubleExt = procs
| where ImagePath matches regex @"\.(pdf|docx?|xlsx?|pptx?|txt|jpe?g|png|zip|rar|rtf|csv|html?)\s*\.(exe|scr|com|pif|bat|cmd|js|vbs|hta|lnk)$"
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = "High", Finding = "Executable with a document-like double extension", Detail = ImagePath;
let mockDir = procs
| where ImagePath matches regex @"^c:\\windows \\|\\[^\\]* \\"
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = "High", Finding = "Image path with a trailing-space directory (mock trusted directory UAC bypass)", Detail = ImagePath;
union knownTypo, lookalike, oddChars, doubleExt, mockDir
| extend Category = "Masquerading"
};
let Det_Misc = () {
let executed = union
(amcache | project Path = tolower(Path), Src = strcat("amcache ", EntryType), When = LastModifyTime),
(shimcachemem | project Path = tolower(FilePath), Src = "shimcache", When = LastModified),
(registry_userassist | where Type == "Value" | project Path = tolower(Name), Src = "userassist", When = LastUpdated)
| where isnotempty(Path);
let evidence = executed
| extend Rule = case(Path matches regex ToolNames, "High|Intrusion / dual-use tool executed or present",
Path matches regex @"^(c:\\windows|%systemroot%|\\\\[^\\]+\\admin\$)\\[a-z0-9]{6,8}\.exe$" and not(Path matches regex @"\\(explorer|regedit|notepad|splwow64|winhlp32|helppane|bfsvc|write|hh)\.exe$"), "High|Random-named executable in the Windows directory (PsExec-style service binary)",
Path matches regex StagingDirHigh, "Medium|Execution evidence for a binary in a staging directory",
"")
| where isnotempty(Rule)
| parse Rule with Severity "|" Finding
| summarize Sources = make_set(Src), When = max(When) by Path, Severity, Finding
| project PID = long(null), Process = "", Severity, Finding, Detail = strcat(Path, " [", strcat_array(Sources, ", "), "] last ", When);
let mutants = union (mutantscan | project Name, PID = long(null)), (handles | where Type == "Mutant" | project Name, PID)
| extend M = replace_regex(Name, @"^(Global|Local|Session\\\d+\\BaseNamedObjects)\\", "")
| extend Family = case(M == ")!VoqA.I4", "Poison Ivy", M in ("gangrenb", "germeonb", "crypt32LogOffPortEvent"), "Pushdo/Cutwail",
M matches regex @"^DC_MUTEX-[A-Z0-9]{7}$", "DarkComet", M matches regex @"^QSR_MUTEX_[A-Za-z0-9]{18}$", "Quasar RAT",
M == "Mutex_RemWatchdog" or M matches regex @"(?i)^Remcos_Mutex_Inj$", "Remcos", M == "AsyncMutex_6SI8OkPnk", "AsyncRAT",
M matches regex @"^(_AVIRA_(2108|2109|210999)|__SYSTEM__[0-9A-F]{8}__|_H_[0-9A-F]{8}_)$", "Zeus",
M matches regex @"^MsWinZonesCacheCounterMutexA0?$", "WannaCry", M in ("uxJLpe1m", "Ap1mutx7"), "Sality",
M in ("kjsidugidf99439", "hsfjuukjzloqu28oajh727190"), "Conti", "")
| where isnotempty(Family)
| summarize PIDs = make_set(PID) by M, Family
| project PID = tolong(PIDs[0]), Process = "", Severity = "High", Finding = strcat("Known malware mutex (", Family, ")"),
Detail = strcat(M, iff(array_length(PIDs) > 0, strcat(" held by PID ", strcat_array(PIDs, ", ")), ""));
let certs = registry
| where Certificatepath =~ @"Software\Microsoft\SystemCertificates" and Certificatesection in~ ("Root", "AuthRoot", "TrustedPublisher")
and CertificateID matches regex @"^[0-9A-Fa-f]{40}$"
| project PID = long(null), Process = "", Severity = "High", Finding = "Root/publisher certificate in a user certificate store (interception / code-signing trust) [T1553.004]",
Detail = strcat(Certificatesection, " ", CertificateID, " ", Certificatename);
let badCerts = registry
| where Certificatename matches regex @"(?i)(DO_NOT_TRUST|FiddlerRoot|Superfish|eDellRoot|DSDTestProvider|mitmproxy|PortSwigger|Charles Proxy|Komodia|PrivDog)"
| project PID = long(null), Process = "", Severity = "High", Finding = "Known interception / compromised root certificate [T1553.004]",
Detail = strcat(Certificatepath, " ", Certificatesection, " ", Certificatename);
let yara = union (yarascan | project PID = long(null), Process = "", Rule, Component), (vadyarascan | project PID, Process = ImageFileName, Rule, Component)
| summarize Hits = count() by PID, Process, Rule
| project PID, Process, Severity = "High", Finding = strcat("YARA rule matched: ", Rule), Detail = strcat(Hits, " hit(s)");

| extend Category = "Other indicators"
};
let IsPublicIp = (ip:string) {
iff(ip contains ":",
not(ip in ("::", "::1", "*") or ip startswith "fe80" or ip startswith "fc" or ip startswith "fd" or ip startswith "ff"
or ip startswith "::ffff:127." or ip startswith "::ffff:10." or ip startswith "::ffff:192.168."),
isnotnull(parse_ipv4(ip)) and not(ipv4_is_private(ip))
and not(ipv4_is_in_range(ip, "127.0.0.0/8")) and not(ipv4_is_in_range(ip, "169.254.0.0/16"))
and not(ipv4_is_in_range(ip, "0.0.0.0/8")) and not(ipv4_is_in_range(ip, "224.0.0.0/3"))
and not(ipv4_is_in_range(ip, "100.64.0.0/10")))
};
let NetConns = () {
let wellKnown = dynamic([21, 22, 23, 25, 53, 80, 88, 135, 139, 389, 443, 445, 636, 1433, 3268, 3389, 5985, 5986]);
let all = union (netscan | extend Src = "netscan"), (netstat | extend Src = "netstat");
let listeners = all | where State == "LISTENING" | distinct LocalPort, PID | extend IsListener = true;
all
| summarize Sources = make_set(Src), Created = min(Created), Owner = take_any(Owner)
by Proto, LocalAddr, LocalPort, ForeignAddr, ForeignPort, State, PID
| join kind=leftouter listeners on LocalPort, PID
| project-away LocalPort1, PID1
| extend LOwner = tolower(Owner), ForeignPublic = IsPublicIp(ForeignAddr), Live = set_has_element(Sources, "netstat"),
Loopback = LocalAddr in ("127.0.0.1", "::1") and ForeignAddr in ("127.0.0.1", "::1")
| extend Direction = case(State == "LISTENING", "listening",
Proto startswith "UDP", "udp",
Loopback, "local",
coalesce(IsListener, false), "inbound",
ForeignPort in (wellKnown) or ForeignPort < 1024, "outbound",
LocalPort in (wellKnown), "inbound",
LocalPort >= 49152 and ForeignPort < 49152, "outbound",
"unknown")
| project-away IsListener
};

Direction == "outbound" and ForeignPort == 88 and LOwner !in ("lsass.exe", "chrome.exe", "firefox.exe", "msedge.exe"), "Medium|Kerberos traffic from a process other than lsass (ticket abuse: Rubeus/Impacket)",
Direction == "outbound" and ForeignPort == 445 and PID != 4 and isnotnull(PID), "High|Outbound SMB from a user process (Impacket, scanner, worm)",
Direction == "outbound" and ForeignPort == 3389 and LOwner !in ("mstsc.exe", "rdcman.exe", "msrdc.exe", "mremoteng.exe", "remotedesktopm"), "High|Outbound RDP from a non-RDP client (tunnel / tool)",
Direction == "outbound" and ForeignPort in (5985, 5986) and LOwner in ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "cscript.exe", "winrs.exe"), "Medium|Outbound WinRM (PowerShell remoting / winrs) to another host",
ForeignPort in (c2Ports) and Direction == "outbound", strcat(iff(ForeignPublic, "High", "Medium"), "|Connection to a port commonly used by C2/RAT/tunnel tools"),
Direction == "listening" and LocalPort in (c2Ports) and LocalAddr !in ("127.0.0.1", "::1"), "High|Listening on a port commonly used by C2/RAT/tunnel tools",
Direction == "listening" and LocalPort in (1080, 9050, 9150) and LocalAddr in ("127.0.0.1", "::1"), "Medium|Local SOCKS/Tor proxy listener",
Direction == "listening" and (LocalPort in (22, 5900, 5901, 7070) or LocalPort between (5900 .. 5910)), "Medium|Remote-access listener (SSH/VNC/AnyDesk) on this host",
Direction == "inbound" and LocalPort == 3389 and ForeignPublic, "High|Inbound RDP from a public address",

| project PID, Process = Owner, Severity, Finding, Detail = strcat(Proto, " ", LocalAddr, ":", LocalPort, " -> ", ForeignAddr, ":", ForeignPort, " ", State, " (", strcat_array(Sources, "+"), ")");

Detail = strcat(CommandLine, " -> ", ForeignAddr, ":", ForeignPort);
let stagingOwner = conns

| where ImagePath matches regex StagingDirHigh or ImagePath matches regex StagingDirMedium
| summarize Endpoints = make_set(strcat(ForeignAddr, ":", ForeignPort), 10) by PID, Owner, ImagePath
| project PID, Process = Owner, Severity = "High", Finding = "Process running from a staging directory owns sockets",

let orphanOwner = conns
| where State !in ("TIME_WAIT", "CLOSED", "CLOSE_WAIT", "FIN_WAIT1", "FIN_WAIT2", "LAST_ACK") and isnotnull(PID) and PID != 0
| join kind=leftanti alive on PID
| project PID, Process = Owner, Severity = iff(Live, "High", "Medium"), Finding = "Socket owned by a PID that is not a running process",
Detail = strcat(Proto, " ", LocalAddr, ":", LocalPort, " -> ", ForeignAddr, ":", ForeignPort, " ", State, " (", strcat_array(Sources, "+"), ")");
union ownerCheck, noArgs, stagingOwner, orphanOwner
| extend Category = "Network"

let Det_ProcessBaseline = () {
let critical = dynamic(["lsass.exe", "services.exe", "wininit.exe", "lsaiso.exe", "smss.exe", "csrss.exe", "winlogon.exe"]);
let core = ProcTree()
| extend LName = tolower(Name)
| join kind=inner (CoreBaseline | project-rename LName = Name) on LName
| extend Base = iff(LName in (critical), "Critical", "High");
let wrongParent = core
| where ParentState == "found" and array_length(Parents) > 0
and not(set_has_element(Parents, tolower(ParentName)))
and not(ParentMayBeGone and isnotnull(ParentExitTime))
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = Base, Finding = "Core process with an unexpected parent",
Detail = strcat(Name, " (", PID, ") was started by ", ParentName, " (", PPID, "); expected ", strcat_array(Parents, " or "));
let missingParent = core
| where not(Exited) and ParentState != "found" and not(ParentMayBeGone) and array_length(Parents) > 0
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = "Medium", Finding = "Parent of a core process is not in memory",
Detail = strcat(Name, " (", PID, ") parent PID ", PPID, " ", ParentState, "; expected ", strcat_array(Parents, " or "), " to still be running");
let wrongPath = core
| where isnotempty(PathRegex) and isnotempty(ImagePath) and not(ImagePath matches regex PathRegex)
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = "Critical", Finding = "Core process name running from an unexpected path",
Detail = strcat(ImagePath, " (expected ", PathRegex, ")");
let wrongSession = core
| where not(Exited) and ((Session == "0" and SessionId != 0) or (Session == "1+" and SessionId == 0))
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = Base, Finding = "Core process in an unexpected session",
Detail = strcat(Name, " runs in session ", SessionId, "; expected session ", Session);
let wrongUser = core
| where not(Exited) and SystemOnly and isnotempty(UserSid) and UserSid != "S-1-5-18"
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = "Critical", Finding = "Core process not running as SYSTEM",
Detail = strcat(Name, " token user is ", UserSid, " ", UserLabel);
let lateStart = core
| where not(Exited) and AtBoot and CreateTime > BootTime + 10m
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = "Medium", Finding = "Boot-time process started late",
Detail = strcat(Name, " started ", CreateTime - BootTime, " after boot (", CreateTime, ")");
let tooMany = core
| where not(Exited) and Singleton != ""
| extend Scope = iff(Singleton == "session", tostring(SessionId), "system")
| summarize Instances = count(), PIDs = make_list(PID), Severity = take_any(Base) by Name, LName, Scope
| where Instances > 1
| mv-expand PID = PIDs to typeof(long)
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity, Finding = "More instances than expected",
Detail = strcat(Instances, " live instances of ", Name, iff(Scope == "system", "", strcat(" in session ", Scope)), ": ", strcat_array(PIDs, ", "));
let lsmOnWin10 = core
| where LName == "lsm.exe" and not(Exited) and toint(toscalar(info | where Variable == "NtMajorVersion" | project Value | take 1)) >= 10
| project PID, Process = Name, Severity = "High", Finding = "lsm.exe on Windows 10+",
Detail = "lsm.exe only exists up to Windows 7; on later versions this name is a masquerade";
union wrongParent, missingParent, wrongPath, wrongSession, wrongUser, lateStart, tooMany, lsmOnWin10
| extend Category = "Process baseline"

### Plugin health (failed, timed out, skipped)

Volatility plugins fail for legitimate reasons: OS build not supported (svclist/svcdiff need Windows 10 1703+ x64, consoles/cmdscan x64 Windows 10+, GUI plugins x64), paged-out structures, smeared images, or missing YARA rules. Every detector that depends on a failed plugin is blind for this image.

**False positives / edge cases:** "skipped" is configuration (e.g. no YARA rules), not an error.

content.json:
## Processes
Know normal, find evil. Core Windows processes have a fixed parent, path, session, account, start time and instance count (SANS *Hunt Evil*); deviations are among the most reliable memory-forensics signals.
Edge cases handled here: names are truncated to 14 characters (`SearchIndexer.`), PIDs are reused (instances are matched on PID + creation time, and a "parent" created after its child is PID reuse, not spoofing), csrss/wininit/winlogon/explorer normally have no living parent, svchost counts vary with memory size, and exited processes stay in memory while handles to them are open.

### Process tree

Every process instance from pslist and psscan, nested under its verified parent. "Found by" shows which plugin saw it (psscan-only + no exit time = unlinked from the process list). Processes whose parent is gone are shown at the root - normal for csrss, wininit, winlogon and explorer.

content.json:
### Core processes deviating from the known-good baseline   `🟥 Critical`

lsass, services, wininit, csrss, winlogon, smss and friends with the wrong parent, path, session, token user, start time or instance count. Malware commonly names itself after a core process and runs from another directory, or a second lsass appears (credential theft tools, masquerading).

**False positives / edge cases:** Multi-session hosts (RDP/terminal servers) have one csrss/winlogon/dwm per session; VMs restored from snapshots can show late start times; third-party tools occasionally ship their own copy of a Windows binary.

<sub>ATT&CK: [T1036.005](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1036/005/)  |  Refs: [1](https://www.sans.org/posters/hunt-evil/) · [2](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/application-management/svchost-service-refactoring) · [3](https://echotrail.io/insights/lsass.exe/)</sub>

### Masquerading names   `🟧 High`

Process names that look like core Windows processes (svch0st, scvhost, lsasss, expl0rer ...), names with right-to-left override or other invisible characters, document-like double extensions and "C:\Windows \System32" mock directories used for UAC bypass.

**False positives / edge cases:** Legitimate near-names are allowlisted (dasHost, sihost, taskhost, smsvchost ...); add your own if a vendor binary trips the similarity check.

<sub>ATT&CK: [T1036.005](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1036/005/), [T1036.002](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1036/002/), [T1036.007](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1036/007/), [T1548.002](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1548/002/)  |  Refs: [1](https://redcanary.com/threat-detection-report/techniques/match-legitimate-name-or-location/) · [2](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/security/current/uac-bypass-attempt-via-windows-directory-masquerading.html)</sub>

content.json:
### Staging paths, svchost without -k, unlinked processes   `🟧 High`

Malware runs from user-writable folders (Temp, AppData, Users\Public, ProgramData, PerfLogs, Recycle Bin, Windows\Tasks, spool\drivers\color ...). Every genuine svchost has "-k <group>". A running process that psscan finds but pslist does not was unlinked from the active process list (DKOM rootkit).

**False positives / edge cases:** Per-user apps (Teams, OneDrive, Zoom) and installers legitimately run from AppData/Temp (Medium). psscan also finds processes from before a reboot; those are filtered by boot time.

<sub>ATT&CK: [T1036.005](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1036/005/), [T1014](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1014/)  |  Refs: [1](https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma/blob/master/rules/windows/process_creation/proc_creation_win_susp_execution_path.yml) · [2](https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference-Mal)</sub>

content.json:
### Core process instance counts

System-wide singletons (lsass, services, wininit, spoolsv, LsaIso ...) must have exactly one live instance; csrss/winlogon/dwm one per session. A second lsass is a classic sign of credential-theft tooling or masquerading.

**False positives / edge cases:** Terminal servers and fast user switching add per-session instances. svchost counts are never alerted on (service splitting since Windows 10 1703).

### Exited and scan-only processes

Short-lived processes are often the attacker's tools (whoami, net, psexec, procdump). They stay in memory while another process holds a handle to them, or as freed pool memory found by psscan. Ordered by creation time to show bursts of activity.

**False positives / edge cases:** Many short-lived processes are normal (updaters, conhost, svchost children). Processes created before the boot time are remnants of a previous boot.

## Execution
What was run and how: command lines, console history recovered from conhost, parent/child relationships that betray exploitation or remote execution, and token anomalies. Command lines live in the process's own memory (PEB) and can be spoofed or paged out - absence proves nothing.

### Suspicious command lines and console history   `🟧 High`

~40 patterns from LOLBAS, Sigma, MITRE ATT&CK, The DFIR Report and CISA ransomware advisories: encoded PowerShell and download cradles, certutil/bitsadmin/mshta/regsvr32/rundll32 abuse, LSASS dumping (comsvcs MiniDump, ProcDump, Mimikatz), hive and NTDS theft, shadow-copy deletion, Defender tampering, AD discovery (AdFind, nltest), PsExec/WMI lateral movement, rclone exfiltration and more. Console history (cmdscan/consoles) recovers commands typed in cmd.exe even after the window was closed.

**False positives / edge cases:** Admin scripts and installers (schtasks /create, sc config, reg add Run). Backup products rotate shadow copies. Low-severity stealth flags alone mean little.

<sub>ATT&CK: [T1059.001](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001/), [T1218](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1218/), [T1003.001](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1003/001/), [T1490](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1490/), [T1562.001](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1562/001/), [T1047](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1047/), [T1569.002](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1569/002/)  |  Refs: [1](https://lolbas-project.github.io/) · [2](https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma/tree/master/rules/windows/process_creation) · [3](https://thedfirreport.com/)</sub>

### Suspicious parent -> child relationships   `🟧 High`

Office spawning shells (malicious documents), WmiPrvSE/wsmprovhost spawning shells (remote WMI/WinRM execution), services.exe spawning cmd (PsExec, getsystem), web servers spawning shells (web shells), lsass with any child, logon/accessibility binaries spawning cmd (sticky-keys backdoor), LOLBins spawning shells.

**False positives / edge cases:** Management agents (SCCM via WMI), build servers (java -> cmd), print drivers (spoolsv -> rundll32 is excluded as it is common). Only parents proven to exist before the child are used, so PID reuse cannot create false pairs.

<sub>ATT&CK: [T1204.002](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1204/002/), [T1047](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1047/), [T1021.006](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1021/006/), [T1569.002](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1569/002/), [T1505.003](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1505/003/), [T1546.008](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1546/008/)  |  Refs: [1](https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma/blob/master/rules/windows/process_creation/proc_creation_win_office_susp_child_processes.yml) · [2](https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma/blob/master/rules/windows/process_creation/proc_creation_win_wmiprvse_susp_child_processes.yml) · [3](https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma/blob/master/rules/windows/process_creation/proc_creation_win_webshell_susp_process_spawned_from_webserver.yml)</sub>

content.json:
### Token anomalies (SYSTEM shells, potato escalation)   `🟧 High`

A cmd/powershell running as SYSTEM inside a user's session (PsExec -s -i, sticky-keys backdoor), a SYSTEM process started by a service account such as IIS AppPool/NETWORK SERVICE (SeImpersonate "potato" exploits), or explorer/sihost running as SYSTEM.

**False positives / edge cases:** Remote management agents that open SYSTEM consoles on purpose. The token user is the first SID reported by getsids.

<sub>ATT&CK: [T1134.001](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1134/001/), [T1068](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1068/), [T1546.008](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1546/008/)  |  Refs: [1](https://jlajara.gitlab.io/Potatoes_Windows_Privesc) · [2](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1134/004/)</sub>

### Recovered console history and screen buffers

Commands typed into cmd.exe (and output shown on screen) recovered from conhost.exe memory - often the clearest record of hands-on-keyboard activity. Typos and retries suggest a human operator.

**False positives / edge cases:** Only builds with Volatility console symbols are supported (x64 Windows 10/11, Server 2019/2022); Windows Terminal (OpenConsole.exe) and PowerShell's own history are not covered. No history does not mean no activity.

<sub>Refs: [1](https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility/wiki/Command-Reference#cmdscan)</sub>

### Hijackable environment variables

COMSPEC pointing somewhere other than cmd.exe, a redirected windir/SystemRoot, user-writable folders early in PATH, and .NET profiler variables (COR_PROFILER*) are used to hijack execution or load DLLs into every .NET process.

content.json:
## Injection & evasion
Code that lives where it should not: executable private memory, hollowed or ghosted processes, DLLs hidden from the loader, threads starting in unbacked memory, direct/indirect system calls that bypass EDR hooks, and patched ETW/AMSI.
Calibrated on real images: browsers, PowerShell/.NET, Chromium WebView and AV engines legitimately hold RWX memory and call syscalls directly, so findings in those processes are downgraded, and processes whose loader lists could not be read at all are not reported as "unlinked".

### Injection and in-memory evasion findings   `🟥 Critical`

malfind regions starting with an MZ header or a Cobalt Strike/Metasploit stager prologue (fc 48 83 e4 f0 / fc e8) are injected code; hollowprocesses/processghosting/pebmasquerade show image tampering; ldrmodules entries unlinked from all loader lists, threads starting in unbacked memory, syscall stubs outside ntdll, ETW functions starting with "ret" (c3) and hardware breakpoints on AmsiScanBuffer/EtwEventWrite are evasion.

**False positives / edge cases:** JIT runtimes and AV (downgraded); resource-only DLLs mapped as data (System32, Low); EDR trampolines can look like hooks. malfind sees only the first 64 bytes and the VAD's initial protection, so RW->RX tricks and stomped headers are missed.

<sub>ATT&CK: [T1055](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1055/), [T1055.012](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1055/012/), [T1055.013](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1055/013/), [T1620](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1620/), [T1562.006](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1562/006/), [T1106](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1106/)  |  Refs: [1](https://www.elastic.co/blog/hunting-memory) · [2](https://github.com/ufrisk/MemProcFS/wiki/FS_FindEvil) · [3](https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/cobalt-strike-memory-analysis/)</sub>

Process hollowing creates the target suspended, rewrites it, then resumes it. A suspended thread in a process that also has hollowing/malfind findings is a strong combination; on its own a suspended thread is usually a background UWP app.

**False positives / edge cases:** Suspended UWP/Store apps (SearchApp, StartMenuExperienceHost, Settings) - shown as Low.

content.json:
## Credentials
Credential theft is the pivot point of most intrusions. This tab shows who reached into lsass, which credential material sits in memory (SAM hashes, LSA secrets, cached domain logons), and settings that make theft easier.
**Handle with care:** hashes and secrets below are live credentials of the investigated organisation. Do not paste them into online lookup or cracking services; crack offline if needed and treat this workbook's database as sensitive.

### Credential access findings   `🟥 Critical`

Handles to lsass.exe with VM_READ/duplicate access held by shells, LOLBins or unknown tools (Mimikatz 0x1010, nanodump 0x1410, ProcDump 0x1fffff, MalSecLogon svchost 0x14c0); credential-tool and Cobalt Strike named pipes; LSA secrets holding cleartext passwords; skeleton key patches; shells that enabled SeDebugPrivilege themselves.

**False positives / edge cases:** AV/EDR, Task Manager, Process Explorer and backup agents open lsass (allowlisted, extend as needed). Dump tools close their handle quickly, so absence proves nothing. A PPL-protected lsass cannot be read by unprotected tools - a VM_READ handle then implies a driver-based bypass.

<sub>ATT&CK: [T1003.001](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1003/001/), [T1003.004](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1003/004/), [T1003.005](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1003/005/), [T1556.001](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1556/001/), [T1134](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1134/)  |  Refs: [1](https://www.splunk.com/en_us/blog/security/you-bet-your-lsass-hunting-lsass-access.html) · [2](https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma/blob/master/rules/windows/process_access/proc_access_win_lsass_susp_access_flag.yml) · [3](https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma/blob/master/rules/windows/pipe_created/pipe_created_hktl_cobaltstrike.yml)</sub>

content.json:
### Local account hashes (SAM)

Local accounts and their NT hashes recovered from the SAM hive in memory. Look for unexpected accounts (new RIDs >= 1000, names mimicking admin accounts or ending in $), stored LM hashes and the same hash on several accounts (password reuse).

**False positives / edge cases:** The "empty" NT hash (31d6cfe0...) is substituted when no hash is stored, so it does not prove a blank password; Guest (501) and DefaultAccount (503) are normally empty and disabled.

<sub>ATT&CK: [T1003.002](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1003/002/), [T1136.001](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1136/001/)</sub>

content.json:
### LSA secrets and cached domain logons

LSA secrets can hold cleartext passwords (DefaultPassword = autologon, _SC_<service> = service account passwords, RAS/VPN credentials). Cached domain logons (DCC2) of privileged accounts on a workstation are a cracking target; the HashcatFormat column is ready for offline cracking (mode 2100).

**False positives / edge cases:** $MACHINE.ACC, DPAPI_SYSTEM and NL$KM exist on every domain member and are informational.

<sub>ATT&CK: [T1003.004](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1003/004/), [T1003.005](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1003/005/)</sub>

content.json:
## Network
Connections and listeners from netstat (live tables) and netscan (pool scan - also closed and freed connections, lower confidence). Ports 80/443/8080/8443 mean nothing on their own: the rules focus on *who* owns a socket (script hosts, LOLBins, notepad, lsass, processes in staging folders) and on unusual ports, directions and peers.
Direction is inferred (listener match, well-known ports, ephemeral ranges) and can be wrong for RPC/DCOM dynamic ports.

### Network findings   `🟧 High`

Script hosts and LOLBins talking to the internet, notepad with a socket (classic injected beacon), argument-less rundll32/regsvr32 with a connection (Cobalt Strike spawn-to), lsass to a public IP, Kerberos from non-lsass (Rubeus/Impacket), outbound SMB/RDP from user processes, known C2/RAT/tunnel ports (4444, 50050, 31337, Tor, SOCKS ...), and sockets owned by processes that are not running.

**False positives / edge cases:** Admin tooling, printing (notepad -> 9100 excluded), approved remote-access tools, stale netscan objects whose owner pointer was reused (prefer netstat-confirmed rows).

<sub>ATT&CK: [T1071](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1071/), [T1571](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1571/), [T1090](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1090/), [T1021.001](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1021/001/), [T1021.002](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1021/002/), [T1558](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1558/)  |  Refs: [1](https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma/tree/master/rules/windows/network_connection) · [2](https://www.cobaltstrike.com/blog/why-is-notepad-exe-connecting-to-the-internet) · [3](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/windows-server/networking/service-overview-and-network-port-requirements)</sub>

### Internet peers per process

Which processes talk to which public addresses. Few connections from an unusual process to one rare address (beaconing) is more interesting than many browser connections. Check the addresses against threat intelligence.

**False positives / edge cases:** Browsers, Teams/OneDrive, Defender and Windows Update talk to many Microsoft/CDN addresses.

content.json:
## Persistence
Autostart locations from the registry hives in memory (Run keys, Winlogon, IFEO, AppInit/AppCert DLLs, LSA packages, BootExecute, print monitors, time providers, netsh helpers, COM/shell hijacks ...), services and scheduled tasks.
Registry values come from the recursive printkey of each hive (`printkey_SOFTWARE`, `printkey_SYSTEM`, `printkey_ntuser*` ...). Memory only holds the parts of a hive that were resident - an absent value is not proof that it is not set. The registry ControlSet in memory may be `ControlSet001`; `CurrentControlSet` is a volatile link.

### Registry persistence findings   `🟧 High`

~35 autostart and hijack locations (Autoruns, Hexacorn, Sigma, Elastic): Run keys with suspicious commands, Winlogon Shell/Userinit changes, IFEO debuggers (Critical on sethc/utilman = sticky-keys backdoor), SilentProcessExit, AppInit/AppCert DLLs, LSA authentication/security/notification packages (mimilib = Mimikatz SSP), BootExecute, ServiceDll outside System32, print monitors, time providers, netsh helpers, Office test DLL, logon scripts, COR_PROFILER, per-user shell open-command hijacks (UAC bypass), hidden accounts.

**False positives / edge cases:** Vendor print monitors, credential providers and password filters (Specops, Azure AD Password Protection), APM profilers, kiosk shells. Several entries with close LastWriteTime raise confidence.

<sub>ATT&CK: [T1547.001](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1547/001/), [T1547.004](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1547/004/), [T1546.012](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1546/012/), [T1546.010](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1546/010/), [T1547.005](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1547/005/), [T1543.003](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1543/003/), [T1548.002](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1548/002/)  |  Refs: [1](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sysinternals/downloads/autoruns) · [2](https://www.hexacorn.com/blog/2017/01/28/beyond-good-ol-run-key-all-parts/) · [3](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elastic/detection-rules/main/rules/windows/persistence_registry_uncommon.toml)</sub>

content.json:
### Services and scheduled tasks findings   `🟧 High`

Services left behind by remote execution (Cobalt Strike jump psexec, Impacket smbexec/psexec, PsExec/PAExec/RemCom, getsystem pipes), service binaries and drivers in user-writable paths, svchost ServiceDlls outside System32, services hidden from the services.exe list (svcdiff), RMM tools, and scheduled tasks running LOLBins with download/obfuscation, tools, or Impacket atexec.

**False positives / edge cases:** PsExec used by admins, approved RMM tools, AV drivers under Program Files. svcdiff/svclist only run on Windows 10 1703+ x64; scheduled_tasks is x64-only in Volatility 2.28.2.

Third-party and attacker tasks: anything whose action is not under C:\Windows or Program Files, with trigger, account and timestamps. Recently created tasks that run at logon/boot are prime persistence candidates.

**False positives / edge cases:** Browser and vendor updaters (Google, Edge, Adobe, OneDrive).
